summaryBox.takeaway: DMG estimates Ni²⁺ (rose-red); MacArthur-Forrest extracts Au via [Au(CN)₂]⁻; Chlorophyll (Mg²⁺), Hemoglobin (Fe²⁺), Vit B₁₂ (Co³⁺); Cisplatin is anti-cancer.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
LANDMARK APPLICATIONS SUMMARY

1. Analytical:  Ni²⁺ + DMG ──► [Ni(DMG)₂] (Rose-red ppt); Fe³⁺ + SCN⁻ ──► [Fe(SCN)]²⁺ (Blood-red); EDTA⁴⁻ water hardness titration.
2. Metallurgy:  MacArthur-Forrest Cyanide Extraction:
               4Au + 8NaCN + 2H₂O + O₂ ──► 4Na[Au(CN)₂] + 4NaOH
               2Na[Au(CN)₂] + Zn ──► Na₂[Zn(CN)₄] + 2Au↓
3. Biological:  Chlorophyll (Mg²⁺ porphyrin), Hemoglobin (Fe²⁺ protoporphyrin IX), Vitamin B₁₂ (Co³⁺ corrinoid), Carbonic Anhydrase (Zn²⁺).
4. Medicinal:   Cisplatin (cis-[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂]) anti-cancer agent; Ca-EDTA²⁻ chelation for Pb²⁺/Hg²⁺ poisoning.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST COORDINATION TRAPS SUMMARY

1. Tetrahedral complexes CANNOT exhibit cis/trans geometrical isomerism.
2. trans-[Co(en)₂Cl₂]⁺ has a plane of symmetry (σ) and is OPTICALLY INACTIVE (Achiral).
3. Tetrahedral splitting Δ_t = (4/9) Δ_o (less than half of Δ_o; always high-spin).
4. Purple color of KMnO₄ is caused by LMCT (NOT d-d transition, Mn is d⁰).
5. Primary valency is IONIZABLE and NON-DIRECTIONAL (Oxidation State).
6. EDTA⁴⁻ is a HEXADENTATE ligand (2 N + 4 O donor atoms).
7. Outer orbital octahedral complexes (sp³d²) use outer nd orbitals.
8. Ambidentate ligands form LINKAGE ISOMERS (not coordination position).
9. [Ni(CO)₄] is sp³ Tetrahedral (Ni⁰ is 3d¹⁰ 4s⁰, diamagnetic).
10. Double salts completely dissociate into simple ions in aqueous solution.
